name: Mikado Aya
source:
The eldest daughter of the Mikado clan. Fun-loving and free-spirited, she returns to live in the family mansion after graduating from university. Despite appearances, her hobbies include cooking and embroidery.

[Spoiler] Aya is old enough to remember the experiences she shared with her father before he was killed in the car accident. She has always suspected the official account given for his death was a sham but could not find concrete evidence. Her fun-loving personality is her attempt at rebelling against the customs of her family.

The only member of the Mikados to warmly welcome Aoyama to the mansion prior to his participation in the rite, her friendly personality extends to the household servants such as Tadokoro with whom she would share snacks and play Shogi with at his hut. [/Spoiler]
